summary: This MS is open only to students already in the Genetics PhD program, and the Bulletin sets no fixed course list: the program decides each student's requirements from their PhD progress. The audit checks the 45 graduate units; the program's sign-off on everything else is checked by hand.

jK5Z8YJn.why: "The program is only open to existing students in the Genetics PhD Program. Requirements vary by student based on their progress in the PhD Program." A requirement a person sets and checks, not information.

patch.name: Requirements set individually by the Genetics PhD Program
